title: Route Decision Schema
description: A record of a route decision binding a requested model to a resolved provider (SW-1510-ROUTE-LOCK). Producer: Faigate adapter. Consumer: SkillWeave route verifier.

run_id.description: The run this decision belongs to.

task_id.description: The task scope this decision belongs to.

request_id.description: The unique request identifier (maps from the routing correlation_id).

parent_request_id.description: The parent request identifier. Empty string for root requests.

requested_model.description: The model alias the caller requested.

answering_model.description: The model that actually answered. Empty string when not yet known or not reported by the provider.

attribution_status.description: Whether the answering model has been confirmed against the requested model.

reservation_id.description: The reservation/slot id. Empty string when none.

attempt_order.description: Ordinal within this attempt (0 = initial decision, 1+ = follow-up updates).

measured_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the decision was recorded.

usage.description: Usage information when available. Empty object when unknown.
